prompt: Some people believe that university students should study whatever they like, while others think they should only study subjects that will be useful in the future. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
essay:
The issue of choosing university subjects has become widely debated. While some people believe that students should be free to study whatever they like, others argue that they should focus only on subjects that are useful for their future careers. In my opinion, students should have the freedom to choose their subjects. This essay will discuss both views before reaching a conclusion.

There are several reasons why allowing students to choose their preferred subjects is beneficial. The main reason is that they are more likely to stay motivated when studying something they genuinely enjoy. This is important because interest can improve concentration and academic performance. As a result, students may achieve better grades and develop stronger skills. For example, a student who is passionate about art may perform much better in design than in engineering. Another important benefit is that personal choice can help students build a career that matches their abilities. This can improve long-term job satisfaction.

However, there are also some benefits to studying subjects that are useful for the future. The main advantage is that these courses may provide better employment opportunities because many industries need workers with practical skills. For example, students who study nursing, engineering, or computer science may find jobs more easily after graduation. Therefore, it is understandable why some people support career-focused education.

In conclusion, both approaches have their own advantages. However, I believe that students should be allowed to choose subjects they enjoy because this can improve motivation and help them build a suitable career. Nevertheless, universities should also provide guidance about future job opportunities.
